A.notes: A has a coherent quiet-hotel idea built from doors, balconies, roofs and a restrained palette, and it communicates the room facts clearly. The typography and illustrations are tasteful and the build looks clean on desktop and mobile, but the structure is fairly conventional and the scroll-frame strip shows little meaningful motion beyond standard page progression.

B.notes: B has the stronger signature: doors and arrival define the whole experience, from the hero panels to the closing 'Find the door,' and the scroll-strip shows a real narrative progression that serves the brief. It is more original and conceptually integrated than A, though the spacing and layout feel less controlled in places—especially on mobile and in the large empty intervals—so craft is not as consistently tight.

raw.why: B carries one distinctive idea further, with more memorable structure and scroll storytelling, while still meeting the functional and accessibility checks.
